test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana was launched on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1st Jan 2017**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a maternity benefit program introduced by the Government of India.
 
• The scheme was launched on **1st January 2017** to provide partial compensation for the wage loss in terms of cash incentives.
 
• It aims to improve the health and nutrition status of pregnant women and lactating mothers.
 
• Under the PMMVY, a cash incentive of Rs. 5,000/- is provided directly to the bank/post office account of Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) for the first living child of the family subject to fulfilling specific conditions relating to Maternal and Child Health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maternity Benefit Programme**

 
 
• Before PMMVY, the Indira Gandhi Matritva Sahyog Yojana (IGMSY) was a central government scheme for pregnant and lactating women to provide partial wage compensation to women for wage-loss during childbirth and childcare and to provide conditions for safe delivery and good nutrition and feeding practices.
 
• On 31 December 2016, the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi, announced that the scheme would be extended to all states and union territories of India with effect from 1 January 2017.
 
• The PMMVY is implemented using the platform of Anganwadi Services scheme of Umbrella ICDS under the Ministry of Women and Child Development in respect of States/UTs implementing scheme through Women and Child Development Department/ Social Welfare Department and through the health sector in respect of States/ UTs where the scheme is implemented by Health & Family Welfare Department.
 
 
 
• **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)**
 
 
• Launched on 2nd October 1975, ICDS is one of the world's largest and unique programmes for early childhood care and development.
 
• It is a centrally sponsored scheme and the cost is shared between the Central and State governments in the ratio of 60:40 for all States & UTs with the legislature except North Eastern and Himalayan States where the ratio is 90:10. For UTs without legislature, the Central Government bears 100% cost.
 
• ICDS offers a package of six services: Supplementary Nutrition, Pre-school non-formal education, Nutrition & health education, Immunization, Health check-up, and Referral services.
